fine_lines.title: also vs too / as well (position)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الثلاثة تعني "أيضًا". also تأتي قبل الفعل الرئيسي (I also go) أو في أول الجملة للتوكيد. too و as well تأتيان في آخر الجملة. too و as well أكثر شيوعًا في الكلام، و also أكثر في الكتابة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: All three mean "in addition". "Also" goes before the main verb (I also go) or at the start for emphasis. "Too" and "as well" go at the end. "Too" and "as well" are common in speech; "also" is more common in writing.

fine_lines.title: too (in addition) vs too (excessive)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: too في آخر الجملة تعني "أيضًا". too قبل صفة أو ظرف تعني "أكثر من اللازم" بمعنى سلبي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Too" at the end means "also". "Too" before an adjective or adverb means "more than is good" (negative).

fine_lines.title: on top of that vs furthermore
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما بمعنى "بالإضافة إلى ذلك". on top of that غير رسمية للكلام، و furthermore رسمية للكتابة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean "also". "On top of that" is informal (speech); "furthermore" is formal (writing).

examples.sentence: I was tired, and on top of that, I was hungry.
The report is clear. Furthermore, it is short.

expressions.meaning_en: I wish the same for you.
A reply that wishes the same thing back.

expressions.phrase: We might as well go home.
expressions.meaning_ar: من الأفضل أن نعود إلى البيت (فلا فائدة من البقاء).
expressions.meaning_en: Going home is sensible; staying won't change anything.
expressions.example: The shop is closed. We might as well go home.

expressions.phrase: I'll have fries with that as well.
expressions.meaning_en: Ordering something extra with your meal.
expressions.example: A burger, please, and I'll have fries with that as well.

grammar.title: All three mean "in addition"
grammar.explanation_ar: also و too و as well تضيف معلومة جديدة. نغيّر بينها حتى لا يصبح الكلام مملًا ومكررًا.
grammar.explanation_en: Also, too and as well add information. We change between them so our English doesn't sound boring and repetitive.
examples: I want a burger. I'll also have fries.

grammar.title: Where to put "also" (the sandwich)
grammar.explanation_ar: مع فعل بسيط واحد: also قبل الفعل (I also go). مع فعل مساعد (be / have / فعل ناقص): الفعل المساعد ثم also ثم الفعل الرئيسي، كأنها شطيرة: I have also been, I could also go, I'm also going.
grammar.explanation_en: With one simple verb: also goes before the verb (I also go). With a helping verb (be / have / modal): helping verb + also + main verb, like a sandwich: I have also been, I could also go, I'm also going.
examples: I also go to the gym.
I have also been to Austria three times.
I could also go to the store.

grammar.title: Emphasis: "also" at the start, "too/as well" at the end
grammar.explanation_ar: للتوكيد نضع also في أول الجملة: Also, don't forget the money. أما too و as well فنضعهما في آخر الجملة للتوكيد: Pick up your clothes and clean your room too!
grammar.explanation_en: For emphasis, put "also" at the start: "Also, don't forget the money." Put "too" or "as well" at the end: "Pick up your clothes and clean your room, too!"
examples: Also, don't forget to get the money.
I'm proud of you and your brother, too.

grammar.title: Other meanings of "too"
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) أكثر من اللازم (سلبي): too expensive, working too much. 2) ردّ: You too = وأنت كذلك. وقد تعبّر You too? عن الدهشة: "وأنت أيضًا؟"
grammar.explanation_en: 1) More than is good (negative): too expensive, working too much. 2) A reply: "You too" = the same to you. "You too?" can also show surprise.

grammar.title: might/may as well
grammar.explanation_ar: might as well / may as well تعني أن الفعل معقول لأن النتيجة ستكون واحدة. لا نقول should as well؛ نستعمل may أو might.
grammar.explanation_en: "Might as well / may as well" means it's sensible to do it because the result will be the same. Don't say "should as well"; use may or might.
examples: The game is finished. We might as well go home.
There's no power. We may as well go to bed.
